items.summary: skill-comply is an automated compliance measurement skill for coding agents. It auto-generates expected behavioral sequences from any .md skill, rule, or agent definition, then builds scenarios at three prompt strictness levels: supportive, neutral, and competing. The skill runs `claude -p`, captures tool call traces via stream-js, classifies behavioral sequences, and reports compliance rates with full tool call timelines. Use skill-comply when custom agent instructions exist but behavior consistency is unverified. Required tools are Read and Bash, making it suited to CI-style agent definition audits before wider rollout.

items.summary: healthcare-phi-compliance is an affaan-m/ecc skill (version 1.0.0) contributed from healthcare practice, providing patterns to protect patient, clinician, and financial data in clinical systems. It guides access control, authentication, database schema design, API response filtering, audit trails, and logging when building features that touch patient records. The skill spans HIPAA (US), DISHA (India), and GDPR (EU) requirements alongside general healthcare data protection. Developers invoke it when designing EHR integrations, patient portals, or clinician dashboards where PHI leakage, weak authorization, or non-compliant logs create regulatory risk. Outputs include concrete schema, API, and logging patterns rather than generic security checklists.
highlights: Covers data classification, access control, audit trails, encryption, and common leak vectors
Applicable to HIPAA (US), DISHA (India), GDPR (EU), and general healthcare data protection
Three-layer model: classification (what is sensitive), access control (who can see it), and audit (who did see it)
Includes patterns for Row-Level Security in multi-tenant healthcare systems
Provides review checklists for data exposure vulnerabilities in clinical APIs and schemas

items.name: agent-platform-skill-registry
items.author: google
items.description: Instantly generate a standardized SKILL.md file and the required directory structure when creating a new agent skill.
items.summary: agent-platform-skill-registry documents interaction with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Skill Registry for skill discovery lifecycle management operation monitoring and local skill scaffolding generation. Core capabilities include querying listing and inspecting revision histories uploading updating or deleting skills checking long-running operation completion and generating new agent skill scaffolds locally. Every workflow begins with mandatory environment validation via python3 scripts/validate_env.py before any registry operation. Authentication requires google-auth and requests libraries plus gcloud auth application-default login. Required environment variables are GCP_PROJECT_ID and GCP_LOCATION such as us-central1. Quickstart search uses python3 scripts/skill_registry_ops.py search with query and top-k flags. Reference docs split operations across query-skills manage-skills monitor-operations and generate-skill guides. The skill targets agents that must register functionality or discover existing capabilities on the enterprise platform rather than local filesystem-only skill folders. LRO monitoring utility covers asynchronous state changes during uploads or updates.
highlights: Skill discovery search list get and revision history against enterprise registry
Upload update delete lifecycle operations with LRO status monitoring
Mandatory validate_env.py check before any registry command
Requires GCP_PROJECT_ID GCP_LOCATION and application-default credentials
Local generate-skill scaffolding via referenced generate-skill workflow

items.name: dart-generate-test-mocks
items.author: flutter
items.description: Generate Mockito mocks with build_runner for unit testing classes with external API or DB dependencies.
items.summary: dart-generate-test-mocks is a Flutter agent-plugins skill for creating mock objects with package:mockito and build_runner. It structures classes for dependency injection, defines @GenerateMocks annotations, runs code generation, and implements unit tests against mocked external services. Use when unit testing classes that depend on APIs, databases, or other complex externals.
highlights: Uses package:mockito with build_runner code generation
Structures code for dependency injection and testability
Workflow from mock definition through generation and test execution
Targets APIs, databases, and complex external service dependencies
